feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 16 August 2026 4:03pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Sunday, 16 August 2026 at 4:00pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

Ridge of high pressure extending from the Azores will decline as various fronts affect the Irish Sea.


##Wind##

Southwest 3 or 4, veering west overnight, backing southwest again tomorrow afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, then outbreaks of light rain spreading from the west this evening, becoming mainly again fair overnight.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in rain.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Southwest 3 or 4, increasing 4 or 5 tomorrow evening, veering west overnight.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight, building slight occasionally moderate overnight.


##Weather##

Occasional rain, imminently becoming more widespread & persistent. Then mainly fair overnight into Tuesday.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain.
